description: Dice.com 2-step apply wizard. Resume pre-loaded from Dice profile, no form fields to fill. Step 1: Resume & Cover Letter (click Next). Step 2: Review (click Submit).

job_detail.description: Job detail page with Apply Now button

login_gate.description: Dice login page - requires manual user login

step1_resume.description: Step 1 of 2: Resume & Cover Letter. Resume is pre-loaded from Dice profile. Optional cover letter upload. Click Next to proceed.

elements.heading: heading:text('Resume & Cover Letter')
elements.coverLetterUpload: button:text('Upload cover letter') or file input

step2_review.description: Step 2 of 2: Review your application. Shows resume, cover letter status, and work authorization. Click Submit to apply.

elements.heading: heading:text('Review your application')
elements.workAuthDisplay: text showing work authorization status (e.g. 'Need H1 Visa')

commonQuestions.question: Are you authorized to work in the US?
What is your work authorization status?

resume.note: Resume is pre-loaded from Dice profile (CV_mediboina_vikash.pdf). No upload needed.

coverLetter.note: Optional cover letter upload. Skip unless specifically required.

workAuthorization.note: Work authorization is pre-filled from Dice profile ('Need H1 Visa'). Display only on review page.

notes: Dice pre-loads everything from user profile - fastest apply flow
Apply Now on job detail redirects to /start-apply which redirects to /wizard
If not logged in, redirects to /dashboard/login?redirectUrl=/job-applications/{id}
After login, automatically redirects to the wizard
Step 1 just shows resume (pre-loaded) and optional cover letter
Step 2 is review only - shows resume, cover letter status, work auth
No fields to fill, just Next → Submit
